HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   C. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.

3. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

9. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.

10. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain International Instruments of Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Global diversity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
